# Warlock Context

> Package: `@warlock.js/context`

> A simple and unified way to share context using AsyncLocalStorage for the Warlock.js framework

## Skills

- [define-context](@warlock.js/context/define-context/SKILL.md): Define a context in @warlock.js/context; use when you need to define context.
- [orchestrate-contexts](@warlock.js/context/orchestrate-contexts/SKILL.md): Orchestrate contexts — contextManager in @warlock.js/context; use when you need to orchestrate contexts.
- [overview](@warlock.js/context/overview/SKILL.md): @warlock.js/context overview for orientation and choosing the focused skill for the task.
